## What are the Course Goals?

::: extrapad
-   This is a very applied class
    -   We are going to learn [**practical skills**]{style="color:#000E2F"}
:::

::: extrapad
-   From the very beginning, we will use
    -   The programming language [**R**]{style="color:#000E2F"}

    -   To analyze [**real data**]{style="color:#000E2F"}

    -   For the purpose of answering [**substantive questions**]{style="color:#000E2F"}
:::

::: extrapad
-   In the process, you might learn some
    -   [**Statistics**]{style="color:#000E2F"}

    -   [**How to code in R**]{style="color:#000E2F"} (R is the name of the program and the name of the language)
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

::: extrapad
-   In this course you will learn how to
    -   [**Basic Programming**]{style="color:#000E2F"}
    -   [**Data Visualization**]{style="color:#000E2F"}
    -   [**Data Analysis**]{style="color:#000E2F"}
:::

::: extrapad
-   Why do you need to learn how to analyze data and evaluate data analyses? (Why are you taking DSDA 1995?)
    -   Most social, political, and business decisions are made based on data
    -   If you cannot do the analysis yourself, you need to at least know how to distinguish a good quantitative study from a poorly conducted one
:::
